title: Film Screening and Live Performance by Joel Mejia Smith
description:
Joel Mejia Smith : it’s been a while…
Saturday, September 26th, 2026
Culver Center of the Arts, Riverside, CA
7:00 PM - FREE - Reservation Link in Bio (space is limited)

Film Screening and Live Performance 
Come check out what I’ve been working on the last couple of years. It’s been a while since I performed live, and I have some new digital projects that are in development. 

Collaborators include Liz Casebolt, Mike Esperanza, Mauro Sacchi, and Andrew Martinez

Close (2019)
a casebolt and smith film
Directed by Joel Mejia Smith, with Liz Casebolt

Fading (2020)
a film by Mike Esperanza and Joel Mejia Smith
Directed by Mike Esperanza

Son (2026) world premiere
a film by Joel Mejia Smith and Mauro Sacchi
Directed by Joel Mejia Smith

11th St Studios: an archive v.1 a digital draft (2026) world premiere 
Directed by Joel Mejia Smith 
Project includes considerable contributions from scholar/artist Andrew Martinez including capture, improvisational scoring, dialogue and theorization. 

This is very much a work in progress tbd digital draft of material that was never intended to be a film. I will be working to the nth hour before i decide to include it in the evening of work

hopefully not my last (2026) - world premiere
Created and Performed by Joel Mejia Smith
Object/Prop drafted, patterned and built by Amelia Charter

come see me perform live for the first time in 5 years!!!!

title: Joel Mejia Smith: It’s been a while…
description: “Joel Mejia Smith: It’s been a while…” is a film screening and live performance that reflects Mejia Smith’s most recent research in live dance making and digital practice. 〰️ The event is Saturday, September 26 at the Culver Center of the Arts in Downtown Riverside. This is a free event, and reserved tickets are required 〰️ watch the full interview in KUCR’s YouTube channel, link in bio @ucr_dance @ucrperforms
location: Culver Center of the Arts, Downtown Riverside

title: Joel Mejia Smith performance: “It’s been a while…”
description: Joel Mejia Smith, Professor of Dance at UC Riverside, talks about his relationship with loneliness and his art. His performance “It’s been a while…” is Saturday, Sept 26, at the Culver Center of the Arts. 〰️ Watch the full interview on the KUCR YouTube channel
